evaluation_contract.complete_success: all three seeds satisfy every registered check; means cannot hide a failed seed
evaluation_contract.data_claim: absent from checked SPEAR use records; not never-seen-by-entire-JCAS-project data
evaluation_contract.integrity_failure_policy: stop immediately and retain failure evidence; no automatic retry
evaluation_contract.method: retained unconditional; no generator, proxy or victim updates
evaluation_contract.model_claim: clean reference was previously used in development; not a newly blind reference
evaluation_contract.model_independence: shared fixed pretraining start and clean reference; not full-pipeline independent seeds
evaluation_contract.performance_failure_policy: report every registered seed; do not retune, resample or add jobs
evaluation_contract.quality_noncollapse: victim must predict both classes on eligible clean pairs
evaluation_contract.quality_reference: same retained clean_reference on exactly the new confirmation scenes
evaluation_contract.quality_reference_difference: new confirmation comparison; NOT historical fixed SAGE24 audit anchor
evaluation_contract.seed_aggregation: equal-weight mean and sample SD; do not pool repeated targets across seeds
evaluation_contract.target_rule: existing SHA identity rule; one eligible true-negative per scene; no prediction filter
evaluation_contract.threshold: existing binary argmax; no threshold fitting

selection.tie_break: lexicographic identifier; one scene per selected group
